open_work: The original marble material and source identities remain. The bowl seats at the original dispensary-top datum 1.16m instead of floating 20mm above it; its original X centre stays, its Y centre moves 35mm back, and its 0.32m diameter leaves 15mm clearance from the unchanged stock-shelf boundary.

The hollow bowl has an actual 30mm base and 20mm lip. The separate turned pestle rests upright with its flat grinding end on that inner base; this is an explicit rest-pose adaptation from the horizontal reference box, not a new control or grinding action.

The bench, balance case and three stock ranks still overlap one another in the original source and require a subsequent composed fitting. Medicine/poison custody, grinding, dispensing, independent services and continuous routes retain separate authority.
